assessments.reasoning: October 2021 §5.8.3 separately quantifies direct operation uses and every transitively referenced fragment. §2.10 Variable use within Fragments explicitly makes the rule per top-level operation. A declaration by a different operation cannot satisfy the operative scope.

challenge.method: Followed a two-hop spread and a shared fragment reached by two operations, only one of which declares the variable, through §§2.10 and 5.8.3.
challenge.results: Variable use is checked per operation across its reachable fragment chain; the declaration in the other operation cannot repair an invalid operation.

limitations: The rule applies per operation, so a shared fragment may require a variable declaration in multiple independent operations.
The assessment is confined to the named documents and revision scope.
